_metadata.description: LLM Evaluator requirement registry - Links operational targets to technical requirements for evaluation framework

requirements.title: Evaluation Job Management
requirements.description: Create, queue, execute, and track evaluation jobs against LLM outputs with comprehensive status monitoring and progress tracking capabilities.

requirements.title: BLEU Score Calculation
requirements.description: Calculate BLEU scores measuring n-gram overlap precision between generated and reference text with brevity penalty.

requirements.title: ROUGE Score Calculation
requirements.description: Calculate ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores measuring recall of n-gram overlap for summarization evaluation.

requirements.title: Semantic Similarity Metrics
requirements.description: Calculate embedding-based similarity scores (BERTScore) using vector comparisons via Qdrant integration.

requirements.title: LLM-as-Judge Evaluation
requirements.description: Implement rubric-based evaluation using LLM reasoning (via Ollama or external APIs) to score outputs against customizable criteria.

requirements.title: Results Storage & Retrieval
requirements.description: PostgreSQL storage for evaluation jobs, results, and metrics with query capabilities for scenario, model, time range, and metric type.

requirements.title: Dashboard Visualization
requirements.description: Real-time metric displays with charts and graphs, comparison views between models/prompts/scenarios, and quality trend monitoring.

requirements.title: REST API Integration Layer
requirements.description: API endpoints for submitting evaluation requests, retrieving results, and webhook support for async result delivery.

requirements.title: RAG Context Relevancy
requirements.description: Evaluate retrieval quality using RAGAs framework context relevancy scoring.

requirements.title: RAG Faithfulness Scoring
requirements.description: Measure if generated answers are grounded in provided context to detect hallucinations.

requirements.title: RAG Answer Relevancy
requirements.description: Score how well generated answers address the original question.

requirements.title: G-Eval Implementation
requirements.description: Multi-step rubric-based evaluation with chain-of-thought reasoning for structured scoring.

requirements.title: Model Comparison Suite
requirements.description: Side-by-side output comparison with A/B testing framework and statistical significance testing.

requirements.title: Quality Gates & Thresholds
requirements.description: Define minimum quality thresholds per scenario/metric with automatic flagging and CI/CD integration.

requirements.title: Export & Reporting
requirements.description: Generate detailed evaluation reports in PDF, JSON, and CSV formats with scheduled generation.

requirements.title: Multi-Scenario Integration
requirements.description: Direct integration with agent-manager, prompt-manager, and knowledge-observatory for ecosystem-wide evaluation.
